name: CkdEpi2021Egfr
title: Estimated GFR by CKD-EPI 2021 (creatinine)
description: Estimates glomerular filtration rate with the race-free CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation and assigns the GFR category.

parameter.name: sex
parameter.documentation: Sex used by the equation: male or female.

parameter.name: sampleDate
parameter.documentation: Date the blood sample was taken; not in the future.

parameter.name: egfr
parameter.documentation: Estimated GFR, mL/min/1.73 m2, rounded to 1 decimal.

parameter.name: stage
parameter.documentation: GFR category G1, G2, G3a, G3b, G4 or G5.
